title: [Master]-Purchase invoice in USD with deferral shows 0 "Amount LCY" in Deferral Schedule View"
summary: Purchase invoices in foreign currency now correctly display the Amount LCY field in the Deferral Schedule view instead of showing zero values.
key_points: Purchase invoices in a foreign currency (USD) with deferrals no longer show 0 Amount LCY in the Deferral Schedule view
The fix is in codeunit 1720 Deferral Utilities
Tests were added in the W1, APAC, BE, CA, RU and US test layers
